in_hebrew.name: Liza
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Liza הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Elizabeth, which means 'God is my oath' or 'God is my promise'. In the New Testament, Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist.

in_greek.name: Liza
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's Promise
in_greek.long_meaning: Liza είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Elizabeth, which means 'God is my oath' or 'God is my promise'. In the New Testament, Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist.

in_latin.name: Liza
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's Promise
in_latin.long_meaning: Liza est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Elizabeth, which means 'God is my oath' or 'God is my promise'. In the New Testament, Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist.
